name: pacto-aa
description: Shared EIP-7702 account for Pacto (squad + username sponsorship)
author: Pacto

scripts.deploy:7702:arbitrum: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy7702Account --rpc-url arbitrum --account $ARBITRUM_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain arbitrum -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url arbitrum --chain arbitrum -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:7702:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy7702Account --rpc-url mainnet --account $MAINNET_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain mainnet -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url mainnet --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.deploy:7702:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy7702Account --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url sepolia --chain sepolia -vvvv'
scripts.simulate-deploy:7702:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script Deploy7702Account --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --chain sepolia -vvvvv'
scripts.verify:7702:arbitrum: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url arbitrum --chain arbitrum -vvvv'
scripts.verify:7702:mainnet: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url mainnet --chain mainnet -vvvv'
scripts.verify:7702:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script Verify7702Account --rpc-url sepolia --chain sepolia -vvvv'
